category: usenet provider (German-language, volume, flat-rate and prepaid tariffs with a 7-day trial)

free_tier.stated: A free 7-day test access that needs only an email address: 'Testzugang, den du ohne Einschraenkungen eine Woche lang nutzen kannst'; the access closes automatically after 7 days. Its data allowance is not stated.
free_tier.notes: The trial runs for 7 days; the unit list has no 'days' term, so the nearest term is none with the period named here.

retention.stated: 7.785 days of retention on the home page ('derzeit 7.785 Tagen')

egress.terms: Volume tariffs of 12 to 240 GB a month, flat-rate tariffs of 1 to 25 MBit plus an Unlimited tariff, and prepaid volumes

interface_detail: NNTP with free SSL; the vendor ships its own client and search index
chaining: Three tariff types (volume, flat-rate, prepaid) with an entry price near EUR 5.
